title: The €222 Million Transfer Record
description:
222 million euros for one player. A world record.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Neymar: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neymar

From Wikipedia (Neymar): in 2010 Santos received bids from Premier League clubs, Chelsea's reported at about £20 million, and he stayed in Brazil; at Barcelona the club doctor suggested he might need to gain weight; July 2016, a new Barcelona contract with a buy-out clause of €200 million rising to €222 million in its second year; 3 August 2017, his representatives paid the €222 million clause and he joined Paris Saint-Germain, the most expensive transfer ever. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: 222 million euros for one player. A world record.
At 18, an English club bid about 20 million pounds. But he stayed in Brazil.
Then Barcelona. Their doctor said he might need to gain weight.
So they set his price at 222 million. Sounds safe. Nobody pays that.
But in 2017, a club in Paris paid it. All of it.
